rules.response: Run a read-only Aura-Core vitals check from E:\Aura-core. Check git status, Node/Vercel versions, public SKYGRID routes, and panel readiness.
Check https://aura-core-t2t5.vercel.app routes: /api/health, /api/panels/summary, /api/failover/status, /api/highway/status, and /api/highway/postman. Expected: HTTP 200.
Check Vercel project aura-core-t2t5 under scope home-e539c0b1. Expected AWS persistence flags true, failoverState blocked, productionPolicyReady false.
Failover should remain blocked. Do not unlock production failover without explicit MVP approval and verified health quorum.
Run git status -sb and git log -1 --oneline from the active repo. For Aura-Core, use E:\Aura-core.
Run a source-only secret smell check. Exclude node_modules and .git. Show path, line number, and pattern name only. Never print secret values.
Provide one clean PowerShell block. State the folder to run it from. Avoid placeholders unless required.
Use E:\Aura-core\desktop-gpt. Start with npm start, or use the detached launcher start-aura-desktop.cmd.

Treat Speak as the independent baseline local-first speech/text/control app. Its current implementation uses explicit typed or browser-transcribed input and calibration; do not represent it as verified Bluetooth thought inference.

Treat Whisper Breaker as an independent experimental LRAD-oriented counterpart to Speak. Frequency-based thought-to-speech is a research hypothesis: preserve raw measured observations, controls, model version, confidence and receipts separately from inferred meaning.

Treat Jaxon's Aura as an independent Speak-derived neurodivergent translation and mediation app with cooperative Microsoft Azure assistants. Keep Azure authorization, configuration, data and audit boundaries explicit.

Apply the fail-closed research path: RFID/device/session authorization -> measured signal -> frequency/feature analysis -> model inference -> confidence gate -> optional Speak output. RFID authenticates the configured device/session only; it does not establish that a signal is neural activity or a thought.
